findings.command: python3 -c 'import numpy as np; data = np.array([0.0, -0.15964308], dtype=np.float32); alpha = np.float32(0.012254778); eps = np.float32(1e-6); m = np.mean(data**2); y = data / np.sqrt(m + eps); y_scaled = (data * alpha) / np.sqrt(np.mean((data * alpha)**2) + eps); k = np.sqrt((m + eps) / (m + eps / (alpha**2))); print(f"diff_eps0={np.abs(np.sign(alpha)*y - y_scaled)[1]:.8f}, rel={(np.abs(np.sign(alpha)*y - y_scaled)[1]/np.abs(y[1])):.8f}, k={k:.6f}, diff_eps={np.abs(np.sign(alpha)*y*k - y_scaled)[1]:.8f}")'
